name: age
text: The highest age index (0: the Dark Age, build.ages) of the amounts or kills that count (count:gather, count:kill).

name: ages
text: The highest age index (build.ages) of a count:queue line.

name: before
text: The value of the event is under it: game seconds (age), years left (destroy WONDER).

name: buildings
text: The building names of a count:build line.

name: by
text: The killer units (kill, count:kill) or the builder units (count:build): names, civs.GROUPS groups or groups joined by +.

name: civ
text: Only for this civilization (a key of game/data/civs.jsonl).

name: gather
text: What a count:gather line counts: a hunted animal, FOLWARK, a trickle technology or KESHIK.

name: killed
text: The killed units of a kill or count:kill line: names, civs.GROUPS groups or groups joined by +.

name: least
text: The value of the event is at least it: a part of 1 (lose site <BUILDING>).

name: mode
text: Only in this game mode (game/data/setup.jsonl, gather.has_mode).

name: need
text: The count that grants a count:<kind> line.

name: part
text: The part of the tiles that an explore line needs explored.

name: tiles
text: The least map size (tiles a side) of an explore line.

name: units
text: The unit names of a count:train, count:queue or win only line.

name: villagers
text: The player has that many live villagers at the event.
